description:
Use this when an agent needs official daily FX reference rates (ECB and Bank of Canada), with a Data BitScore. kind="intuitive" (the default) is one pair (default EURUSD); kind="stats" is the multi-currency table and optional remittance conversion; kind="pro" adds history; kind="signals" is notable FX moves plus official policy-rate context. Reference rates, not live tradable quotes. Informational only, not a buy, sell or hold. Example: get_finance_data(kind="stats"). Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 5 sats or $0.003 USDC. Use this when an agent needs the latest official daily FX reference rate for one currency pair (default EURUSD; set pair=USDMXN for a remittance corridor) and a reserved gold/silver slot. These are official dailies, not live tradable quotes and not a send-money quote. MCP: get_finance_data(kind="intuitive", pair="USDMXN").
- kind="stats": 17 sats or $0.01 USDC. Use this when an agent needs a multi-currency official FX table, cross rates and a remittance-corridor conversion (optional amount, from, to). Official dailies from the ECB and the Bank of Canada, not live tradable or send-money quotes. MCP: get_finance_data(kind="stats", amount=100, from="USD", to="MXN"). Informational only, not investment advice.
- kind="pro": 33 sats or $0.02 USDC. Use this when an agent needs official FX history and changes, and optionally SEC EDGAR fundamentals and filings for one US ticker (?symbol=AAPL). History covers about 30 days (days=7 to 90). MCP: get_finance_data(kind="pro", pair="EURUSD", symbol="AAPL"). Not endorsed by the SEC, the ECB or the Bank of Canada. Informational only, not investment advice.
- kind="signals": 33 sats or $0.02 USDC. Use this when an agent needs notable official FX-rate moves and ECB/BoC divergence, plus a Fed vs ECB vs Bank of Canada policy-rate comparison, the Treasury yield-curve shift versus recent history, and inversion state, with a BitScore for freshness and source agreement. Official-source speed, not a news wire. Not endorsed by the Federal Reserve, the U.S.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
